supporting_observations.claim: The recurring successful HTTPS proxy connections to update.casebinder.com are attributed by Sysmon and Windows Filtering Platform records to C:\Program Files\CaseBinder\casebinderupd.exe, running as noah.kim.

The observed successful checks occur at roughly five-minute intervals: 13:41, 13:46, 13:50, 13:55, 14:01, and 14:06 UTC. The 14:11 attempt received proxy status 407, and the updater exited shortly afterward.
The observed executable path and destination match the inventory's approved CaseBinder updater and its expected five-minute update check, supporting a benign explanation for the alerted pattern.
The records shown do not substantiate a matching CaseBinder check before 13:41 UTC; the 13:31 proxy attempt shown is to statics.teams.cdn.office.net and received status 407.

known_telemetry_limitations: The proxy records establish the requested destination and tunnel outcome, but the supplied records do not show HTTPS payload contents.
The records establish process path and network attribution, but do not provide a hash or signature-validation result for casebinderupd.exe.
The records shown substantiate the recurring CaseBinder checks from 13:41 onward, but do not independently establish the reported pattern's start around 13:30.
claims_not_established: Whether the CaseBinder updater binary is authentic and unmodified.
What content, if any, was exchanged inside the HTTPS tunnels.
Whether additional periodic connections occurred before 13:41 that are not represented in these records.
unrelated_findings: Google Drive File Stream started under noah.kim; the inventory approves OneDrive and states no other cloud-storage services are approved. Review separately. (T146-00023, T146-00024, T146-00025)
FILE-MAP-01 recorded an SMB network logon as ANONYMOUS LOGON from WS-NKIM-01. The supplied record does not establish what resource, if any, was accessed; review separately. (T146-00164, T146-00168)
WS-NKIM-01 attempted a proxy connection to statics.teams.cdn.office.net without proxy authentication; it received status 407. This is separate from the CaseBinder pattern. (T146-00042, T146-00043)
